Lessons.Title: Two Truths and a Lie (optional)
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will apply your understanding of multiplication and measurement conversion to compare facts about animals.
This lesson is optional because it does not address any new mathematical content standards. This lesson does provide you with an opportunity to apply precursor skills of mathematical modeling. In this lesson, you write true and false statements involving multiplicative comparisons and unit conversions.
Core relationship: Justify true and false mathematical statements. For the optional game, test each claim using known unit relationships before choosing the lie.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Notice and Wonder: Animal Facts	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Two Truths and a Lie	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Gallery Walk: Two Truths and a Lie	 (20 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: Which is the lie: 100 cm = 1 m; 2,000 m = 2 km; 1 kg = 100 g?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Write one true and one false fact about 1 liter.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
